observed: The open Resolution select popup extended below the closed field. Its upper option area appeared as a black rectangle with no legible option labels. The lower area was pale blue with repeated thin dark diagonal/horizontal strokes or text-like fragments instead of readable rows.

The same malformed popup remained visible in two successive screenshots. Individual option names and row boundaries could not be reliably read; no definite wrong option order or wrong row coordinates was established.
The closed Resolution field before opening clearly read Keep source resolution. After global key7 then Return it clearly read720p; the exact selected value was visually verified before Apply.

Adjacent ordinary page fields, labels, time inputs, buttons and surrounding layout remained readable in those screenshots. The Audio policy select popup subsequently rendered readable Copy where qualified / Precision AAC / Precision FLAC choices.
This observation concerns the open Resolution popup rendering, not evidence that the underlying page layout or all select controls were corrupted.
